trait_options.label: Net Presence
trait_options.note: Forwards who hang in front for screens / deflections (Backes, Kesler, Bertuzzi).

trait_options.label: Net Agitator
trait_options.note: Forwards who screen / distract the goalie (Ott, Lucic, Hartnell).

trait_options.label: Setup Man Low
trait_options.note: Forwards who set up down low looking for slot shooters (Backlund, Stepan, Thornton).

trait_options.label: Shooter Slot
trait_options.note: Forwards positioned in the slot when set up in the O-zone (Alfredsson, Benn, Voracek).

trait_options.label: Rush Joining D
trait_options.note: Defensemen who lead the rush (Del Zotto, Faulk, Letang).

trait_options.label: Dump & Chaser
trait_options.note: Grinder forwards; strong board play (Fisher, Callahan, Neil).

trait_options.label: Shoots On The Rush
trait_options.note: Forwards more likely to shoot off the rush than dump in (Sharp, Setoguchi, Neal).

trait_options.label: Drives The Net
trait_options.note: Forwards who drive hard to the net (Crosby, Clarkson, Lucic).

trait_options.label: Pinching D
trait_options.note: Defensemen willing to risk pinches in the O-zone (Beauchemin, Goligoski, Leddy).

trait_options.label: Finishes Hits
trait_options.note: Any skater; finishes the hit after the puck is gone (Clutterbuck, Martin, Hamonic; Matt Cooke is canonical).

trait_options.label: One Timer Specialist
trait_options.note: Forwards who set up cleanly for one-timers (Stamkos, Whitney, Parise); enables the one-knee animation.

trait_options.label: Puck Protector
trait_options.note: EBOOT debug-list name (superseded the OP's 'Passes Through Traffic' guess).

trait_options.label: Offensive Opportunist
trait_options.note: Cherry-pickers who anticipate the quick breakaway pass (Gaborik, Semin, P. Kane).

trait_options.label: Non-Physical
trait_options.note: Any skater; rarely throws hits, positions away from contact (Raymond, Bouwmeester, Zanon).

trait_options.label: Hip Checker
trait_options.note: Defensemen who hip-check zone-entry forwards (Orpik, Emelin, Hamhuis, Ballard).

trait_options.label: Dangler
trait_options.note: EBOOT debug-list name (superseded the OP's 'Puck Protectors' guess).

trait_options.label: Hard Backchecker
trait_options.note: Forwards who play with energy and excel defensively (Brown, Couturier, Bergeron).

trait_options.label: Lazy Backchecker
trait_options.note: EBOOT-listed; debug-string position sits between Hard Backchecker and Peripheral Player, so almost certainly slot 18.

trait_options.label: Peripheral Player
trait_options.note: Forwards who prefer the corners and shy from net traffic (Tlusty, Vrbata, Parenteau).

trait_options.label: Shooter Slot (Defense)
trait_options.note: Defensemen who carry the puck into the slot to shoot (Gonchar, Keith, Doughty); 18 known players, all offensive D.

trait_options.label: Puck Moving Defenseman
trait_options.note: Defensemen who QB the power play (Doughty, Visnovsky, Ekman-Larsson, Chara, B. Campbell).

trait_options.label: Perimeter Sniper?
trait_options.note: Best guess (seamor3 / forum post #18). Observed on Frolik, Radulov, Bozak, Seguin, Kovalchuk.

trait_options.label: Explosive Speed
trait_options.note: EBOOT name 'Speedster'. Any skater; elite first step (Higgins, Marleau, Havlat).

trait_options.label: Risky Dangler?
trait_options.note: Best guess (seamor3 / forum post #18). Observed on Eberle, Oshie, Hemsky, Raymond.

trait_options.label: Risk Taker, D-Zone?
trait_options.note: Best guess (seamor3 / forum post #18). Observed on Antropov, Filppula, Eberle, H. Sedin.

trait_options.label: Risk Taker, O-Zone?
trait_options.note: Best guess (seamor3 / forum post #18). Only 4 known holders: Stempniak, Seguin, D. Sedin, Kesler.

trait_options.label: Booming Shot From Point
trait_options.note: EBOOT name 'Big Shooter'. Heavy point shots, distinct animation (Souray, Garrison; forwards Ovechkin, Kovalchuk).
